hypothesis: Smaller data-encoding frequencies may improve exact ranking under shifted input ranges while shrinking measurable probability gaps.
choice_origin: Frequency grid1/.5/.25/.125 chosen after seeing scale4 failure in experiment10; this is an exploratory intervention, not pre-existing confirmation.
design: Freeze five circuit fits; new 128-episode datasets,16 candidates; input scales1/2/4; 512 and8192 total shots/query;10 repeats. Evaluate full grid, not a selected winner.
scope: No train/test-informed retraining or oracle range normalization; external frequency multiplier applies equally to query and key. Sampling from verified ideal two-qubit Born probabilities.
